lines.en: What did you want to be when you were younger?
I bet it was something silly, like an astronaut.
That didn’t turn out all too well, though...did it?
Now, the days tick on like the smallest hand of an analog clock- passing over line after line because you’ve seen them so many times that they’re just not exciting enough to make you stop anymore.
Everything today is exactly the same as it was yesterday.
You wind yourself up and go around in circles.
You know you’re not heading anywhere in particular, but that’s never stopped you before.
Because you know deep within your heart that you determine how everything else moves.
If you don’t do your job, the more important cogs in the machine won’t be able to do theirs.
Move faster!
Move quicker!
The world stops existing the second you believe it to not exist!
Don’t let all of it die!
We’re all built around you!
It’s all built around you...
Why, in this room full of things designed to make you happy, do you still struggle to find your place?
Why do you refuse to grow?
Why can you not sit back and accept that you are the king here?
There is no god. There is no heaven. There is no hell.
There’s just this.
Love it.
Cherish it.
Embrace it.
For it is all you have now.
Those days when you were younger, when you were still unable to touch the tips of your fingers together as they curled around the pole of a stop sign...
Those days are gone.
Now, your hands are bigger. Your body is stronger.
It doesn’t grow much anymore, but your brain still does.
You know things now.
Not to touch the stove when it’s on.
Not to put metal in microwaves.
Not to pull on a cat’s tail.
Things you had to learn because that’s just how the world works.
And now-
You’re here again.
Hiding away in the darkest corners of your mind, distracting yourself with thoughts of better days, because you’re afraid of opening your eyes and seeing how terrible it’s all become.
You are no astronaut.
You’re just another piece in a much bigger puzzle.
It always comes back to puzzles, doesn’t it?
I don’t want you here anymore.
Open your eyes.
: Oh, Sensei!
: I heard from Uta that you ran off after Molly to try and make her less drunk or something.
: How did that go?
: I don’t really know.
: Oh. Okay. Weird.
: I guess that’s kind of what it’s like dealing with drunk people sometimes, though.
: But, if it makes you feel any better, you can hang out with me now!
: I figured I’d try and catch you after you were done saving Molly from self-destruction or whatever and...apologize for all of the weird stuff I was saying earlier.
: Everything you say is weird, Io. You don’t have to apologize for it.
: I...kinda do.
: It’s ingrained into my personality at this point, and if I don’t apologize to the people I care about for everything I do, I believe they’ll get sick of me and stop caring entirely.
: Thankfully, that list of people is only two right now.
: And while I’d like to say this means I don’t have to apologize much, I fuck up very frequently and will apologize to both you and Uta until you’re...forced to...
: What...happened?
: What do you mean?
: You look...
: Different from how you normally look.
: So I figured I’d ask if something happened.
: Nothing happened.
: Yeah. Okay.
: Just forget it then! I mean, if you say it was nothing, it was definitely nothing. And I’m not going to make a big deal out of something that is literally nothing you know? Hahah...
: Hah...
: Was it...something I said?
: Not everything is about you, Io.
: In fact, most things aren’t about you.
: So before you go and start over analyzing however I look or...how I’m acting right now, run that through your head a few times and see if it sticks.
: If not, it’s probably best to just leave me alone.
: I shouldn’t be here anyway.
: I like you.
: Yeah. You’ve said that before.
: I like you a lot.
: And I’m sure that no matter what that...thing that I’m not involved in is, I’ll still like you.
: I don’t expect that to make you smile or for you to just...get over it or anything, but I felt the urge to tell you again.
: I see.
: Do you want a hug?
: Not right now.
: I’ll hug you in my mind instead.
: Do whatever you want.
: Do you feel the mind-hug? I’m squeezing really hard.
: Sure. Whatever.
: I won’t pretend to know what’s wrong, and I won’t ask you to tell me any secrets that you’re trying to keep hidden or something.
: One, because the burden of knowing would probably eat me up from the inside.
: And two, because I don’t expect you to always know what’s wrong with me either.
: We can keep being...eggshells around each other.
: Do you mean “walking on” eggshells?
: No. I mean being eggshells.
: The good parts of us have already been spilled out and used up by somebody else, and all that’s left is the useless white part.
: I’m crafty, though. And good with my hands. So if you let me hold you like I’d hold an egg, I can try to fix you up and make you look new again.
: Or, if that doesn’t work, decorate you and make you look better than ever before.
: But you’ll still always be empty inside.
: I can't change that part.
: I think it’s your turn to talk now.
: I don’t think I’m an...eggshell, Io.
: Why not?
: Because “empty” isn’t the right word.
: There’s still something inside of me. I can feel it moving around.
: I just know it isn’t good. Or it’s not supposed to be there or...something.
: I don’t know. This analogy is annoying.
: Wanna crack yourself open and see if it’s a cool little worm or something?
: How would I even-
: By running away with me.
: We can go anywhere in Kumon-mi. And I won’t judge you if that...wiggly thing inside of you starts to come out.
: I’ll share it with you...since you’re already sharing some of what makes me want to curl up and wither away.
: Make your home inside of me, Sensei.
: Let’s try our best to be happy together, because god knows we can’t do it on our own.
: There is no god.
: You’re right. There is no god.
: No god would make a world as cruel as this.
: Also, I’m not running away with you.
: Darn it.
: Guess I’ll have to wait until your next mini-bout of vulnerability to swoop in for the kill.
: There you are!
: Guess what I just did.
: Probably something evil or mischievous.
: No, actually.
: I just finished walking Noriko to the bus stop because someone made her cry.
: That someone is you. You are the someone.
: Thank you for clarifying. I was unaware.
: Oh, the green girl is here too. Hi, green girl.
: It’s strange that you keep calling me that despite trying to talk to me on a weekly basis.
: You’d think that if you really wanted to talk to me, you’d learn my name.
: Do you know my name?
: Kirin.
: Io.
: See? I knew.
: Wow. Good job.
: Are we officially friends now?
: No. But we are officially acquaintances, which I suppose is more than nothing.
: I will take what I can get.
: What’s up your ass? Don’t tell me the news about Noriko hit you that hard.
: Actually, do tell me if that’s what it is. I’m sure she’d be happy to hear that you’re thinking about her in literally...any sense of the word.
: I’m just feeling a little out of it.
: In what way?
: Were you drinking too? Because I literally told Molly to wait for me, and if you went off and took my place while I was being a good friend, I’m gonna be pissed off.
: Molly-
Molly is drunk.
Molly is sad.
: Do you two want to go somewhere else?
: Like...away from the party? I literally just got back.
: Plus, it is fucking freezing out there and my nipples are going to cut holes in my lingerie if they get any harder.
: I’d be happy to go somewhere else with you, Sensei. I just don’t see the need for Kirin to come as well.
: Oh, you don’t? Well, that’s too bad. Because my nipples are magically soft now and there’s nothing you can say that’ll stop me from coming.
: I’ve already annoyed Sensei enough tonight, so I’ll hold the rest of my arguments until you do something to piss me off.
: So, where are we going?
: You had something in mind, right?
: Not really.
: Just...anywhere, I guess.
: I need to walk.
: Oooookay. Well are you going to at least say bye to everyone or-
: I need to walk now.
: I...need to walk...
: Jesus, why is everyone but me being so fucking dramatic tonight?
: Sensei! Wait for me!
: Oh, god damnit...
I walk.
I walk and I walk and I walk.
Io and Kirin are there too.
The three of us walk together.
We walk to all kinds of places.
A tree.
A bench.
A garbage can.
Another tree.
It is a fun and successful ending to the Halloween party.
I am glad that nothing bad happened tonight.
Nothing bad happened tonight.
I am a good person.
I receive several calls and text messages after I disappear.
I ignore them all but one.
: Hhiy...is molly
: I got youe number from Futa
: Futa
: lol autosuggest
I don’t respond.
I don’t know what to say.
: Did yo leave???
: Come back Sir
: need to know whst happened
I walk some more.
My phone stops vibrating.
I bring Molly Kirin and Io back to the dorm.
Why am I thinking about Molly?
I don’t want to think about MOLLY anyone.
I DON’T WANT TO THINK
What did I want to be when I was younger?
I escape again.
I run.
I walk.
Phone beep again.
Remove.
Tap.
: Was I a good protagonist?
You have unlocked Molly’s phone number!
